In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the keystone species is the most important factor in ensuring UP.
the keystone species is the only species that can ensure UP of the system, and the effect of the other prey species on UP is negligible.
UP is a complex function of the prey species' profitability values to the predator and the magnitude of the carrying capacity of the keystone prey species.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
UP is promoted when the prey species are not too different in profitability and when the keystone prey species is not too vulnerable to predation.
the role of the keystone species in the system is more critical than the effect of the foraging rules and interspecific competition in UP.
UP is possible if the keystone prey item has a large population size, a low predation rate, a large carrying capacity, and a high profitability value.

the role of the keystone prey item as the main food source for the predator and its carrying capacity, rather than the predator's foraging decision rules, are crucial to whether the prey- one predator system is persistent or not.
